moves.label: M1
moves.paraphrase: The sabbath period comes to an end.
moves.outcome: a new time-window opens for action
moves.sitz: a first-century teller narrating a post-sabbath dawn in Judea

moves.label: M2
moves.paraphrase: The three named women purchase aromatic spices in order to anoint the body.
moves.agent: Mary Magdalene, Mary of James, and Salome
moves.outcome: spices in hand for the intended anointing of the corpse
moves.sitz: marketplace-purchase for burial-care in first-century Judea

moves.label: M3
moves.paraphrase: Very early on the first day of the week the women travel to the tomb as the sun is rising.
moves.outcome: arrival at the tomb
moves.sitz: pre-dawn walk to a rock-cut tomb outside jerusalem

moves.label: M4
moves.paraphrase: The women speak among themselves.
moves.outcome: a question is voiced among them (see M5)
moves.sitz: anxious conversation en route to a sealed tomb

moves.label: M5
moves.paraphrase: They ask who will roll the stone away from the tomb's entrance for them.
moves.outcome: the tomb-mouth would be opened for them
moves.sitz: women anticipating a physical obstacle at the tomb

moves.label: M6
moves.paraphrase: Looking up, they perceive the state of the stone.
moves.outcome: they register the tomb's altered state
moves.sitz: first sight upon reaching the tomb

moves.label: M7
moves.paraphrase: The stone has already been rolled away by an unnamed agent.
moves.outcome: the tomb stands open
moves.sitz: a pre-opened tomb encountered at dawn

moves.label: M8
moves.paraphrase: The narrator notes, as an aside, that the stone was extremely large.
moves.outcome: the size of the stone underlines the wonder of M7
moves.sitz: a narrator glossing the scene for the audience

moves.label: M9
moves.paraphrase: The women enter the tomb.
moves.outcome: they are now inside the burial chamber
moves.sitz: crossing the threshold of a rock-cut tomb

moves.label: M10
moves.paraphrase: Inside, they see a young man in a white robe sitting on the right-hand side.
moves.substrate: a young man seated on the right, wrapped in a white robe
moves.outcome: an unexpected figure is registered
moves.sitz: eyewitness encounter inside the tomb

moves.label: M11
moves.paraphrase: The women are overcome with astonishment.
moves.outcome: their inner state shifts to alarm
moves.sitz: reaction to an unexpected figure at a burial site

moves.label: M12
moves.paraphrase: The young man addresses the women.
moves.outcome: a multi-part announcement is delivered (M13–M20)
moves.sitz: messenger speech at an empty tomb

moves.label: M13
moves.paraphrase: He tells them to stop being alarmed.
moves.outcome: cessation of alarm is enjoined
moves.sitz: messenger calming those who have just entered the tomb

moves.label: M14
moves.paraphrase: He identifies the object of their search as Jesus of Nazareth, the crucified one.
moves.substrate: Jesus the Nazarene, the crucified one
moves.outcome: their errand is named and identified
moves.sitz: messenger naming what the visitors have come to do

moves.label: M15
moves.paraphrase: He announces that Jesus has been raised by an unnamed agent.
moves.outcome: Jesus is in the state of having-been-raised
moves.sitz: first proclamation of resurrection at the tomb

moves.label: M16
moves.paraphrase: He states that Jesus is not present at this location.
moves.outcome: the empty tomb is named as evidence of M15
moves.sitz: pointing to physical absence at the burial site

moves.label: M17
moves.paraphrase: He directs them to look at the very spot where the body had been laid.
moves.substrate: the place where they laid him
moves.outcome: visual verification of the empty spot is enjoined
moves.sitz: messenger inviting inspection of the burial slab

moves.label: M18
moves.paraphrase: He commands them to depart from the tomb.
moves.outcome: they are commissioned to move outward
moves.sitz: messenger dispatching witnesses from the site

moves.label: M19
moves.paraphrase: He commands them to relay the message to the disciples and specifically to Peter.
moves.outcome: a transmission-chain is opened from women to disciples (M20–M21)
moves.sitz: commissioning women as first messengers of the resurrection kerygma

moves.label: M20
moves.paraphrase: The message to be relayed: Jesus is going ahead of the disciples into Galilee.
moves.outcome: a rendezvous-locus is designated
moves.sitz: redirecting the disciples from Jerusalem back to Galilee
moves.narrator: the young man via the women (reported)

moves.label: M21
moves.paraphrase: There, in Galilee, the disciples will see him — as he himself had said to them earlier.
moves.outcome: a future encounter between the risen Jesus and his followers
moves.sitz: messenger issuing a future-oriented guarantee anchored in Jesus' prior word
moves.narrator: the young man via the women (reported)

moves.label: M22
moves.paraphrase: The women rush out of the tomb in flight.
moves.outcome: the women leave the burial site in panic
moves.sitz: eyewitnesses reacting to a messenger's proclamation at the empty tomb

moves.label: M23
moves.paraphrase: Trembling and ecstatic terror grip the women from within.
moves.outcome: the women are inwardly overwhelmed
moves.sitz: a narrator glossing the affective ground of the flight in M1

moves.label: M24
moves.paraphrase: They tell no one anything at all.
moves.outcome: the commissioned message is not transmitted
moves.sitz: the abrupt Markan ending — silence at the point of transmission

moves.label: M25
moves.paraphrase: They are afraid.
moves.outcome: fear stands as the cause given for their silence
moves.sitz: narrator glossing the ground of the silence in M3

moves.label: M26
moves.paraphrase: The women pass on, in brief, everything they had been commanded to relay to Peter's circle.
moves.substrate: all the things that had been commanded
moves.outcome: the resurrection commission reaches the Petrine circle
moves.sitz: a later scribal repair of the abrupt silence at M3

moves.label: M27
moves.paraphrase: Jesus himself dispatches through the women, from east to west, the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation.
moves.substrate: the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation
moves.outcome: a cosmic-scale spread of the resurrection kerygma
moves.sitz: a liturgical-sounding coda framing the women's report as universal proclamation

moves.label: M28
moves.paraphrase: The teller seals the coda with a liturgical affirmation.
moves.outcome: the coda is ritually sealed
moves.sitz: liturgical-scribal signature closing the shorter ending

moves.label: M29
moves.paraphrase: Jesus rises early on the first day of the week.
moves.outcome: Jesus is in the state of having risen
moves.sitz: a scribal supplement re-narrating the resurrection as active, not divine-passive

moves.label: M30
moves.paraphrase: He shows himself first to Mary of Magdala, out of whom he had earlier expelled seven demons.
moves.outcome: Mary becomes the first witness of the risen Jesus
moves.sitz: first-witness tradition anchored to Mary of Magdala

moves.label: M31
moves.paraphrase: Mary goes and reports to those who had been with him, who are grieving and in tears.
moves.substrate: the fact of the appearance (opaque in the text)
moves.outcome: the news reaches the grieving companions
moves.sitz: first female witness relaying to a bereaved inner circle

moves.label: M32
moves.paraphrase: The companions hear the twin claim: that he is alive and that Mary has seen him.
moves.agent: those who had been with him
moves.outcome: the reported content reaches their ears (see M12, M13)
moves.sitz: reception of first-witness testimony by the inner circle

moves.label: M33
moves.paraphrase: Jesus is alive.
moves.outcome: the resurrection is asserted as an ongoing state
moves.sitz: content of Mary's report as heard

moves.label: M34
moves.paraphrase: He has been seen by Mary.
moves.outcome: eyewitness-warrant is attached to the 'he lives' claim
moves.sitz: content of Mary's report as heard

moves.label: M35
moves.paraphrase: They refuse to believe it.
moves.agent: those who had been with him
moves.outcome: the first witness's testimony is rejected
moves.sitz: first refusal in a scribal disbelief-motif chain

moves.label: M36
moves.paraphrase: After this, Jesus shows himself in a different form to two of them as they are walking out into the countryside.
moves.outcome: a second, altered-form appearance to two witnesses
moves.sitz: a scribal summary of an emmaus-type road appearance

moves.label: M37
moves.paraphrase: Those two go back and report to the remaining companions.
moves.substrate: the appearance they had witnessed (opaque in the text)
moves.outcome: a second wave of first-witness testimony reaches the group
moves.sitz: secondary transmission-attempt in the disbelief-motif chain

moves.label: M38
moves.paraphrase: Even those witnesses they refuse to believe.
moves.substrate: the two road-witnesses (and, through them, their report)
moves.outcome: a second testimony is rejected, extending the disbelief pattern
moves.sitz: second refusal in the disbelief-motif chain

moves.label: M39
moves.paraphrase: Later, Jesus shows himself to the eleven while they are reclining at table.
moves.outcome: the risen Jesus is present to the full inner group
moves.sitz: scribal summary of a table-appearance to the eleven

moves.label: M40
moves.paraphrase: He rebukes them for their unbelief and stubbornness of heart, on the ground that they had not trusted the earlier eyewitnesses of his rising.
moves.substrate: their unbelief and hardness of heart
moves.outcome: the eleven are named as culpable non-believers of prior testimony
moves.sitz: a scribal moralizing gloss on the disbelief-motif chain

moves.label: M41
moves.paraphrase: He addresses them with a commission.
moves.outcome: a multi-part commission is delivered (M4–M13)
moves.sitz: solemn commissioning speech attached to the resurrection appearance

moves.label: M42
moves.paraphrase: He commands them to go out into the whole world and proclaim the good news to every creature.
moves.outcome: universal proclamation of the gospel is enjoined
moves.sitz: universal-mission commission

moves.label: M43
moves.paraphrase: The one who trusts the message and is baptized will be rescued.
moves.substrate: the one who has believed and been baptized
moves.outcome: salvation for the believer-baptizand
moves.sitz: soteriological rule attached to the commission

moves.label: M44
moves.paraphrase: The one who refuses to trust the message will be condemned.
moves.substrate: the one who has refused to believe
moves.outcome: condemnation for the disbeliever
moves.sitz: the negative counterpart of the salvation-rule

moves.label: M45
moves.paraphrase: The following confirming signs will accompany those who come to trust.
moves.outcome: a sign-catalogue is opened as warrant for the believers (M8–M13)
moves.sitz: charismatic sign-catalogue attached to the commission

moves.label: M46
moves.paraphrase: Invoking his name, they will drive out demons.
moves.outcome: demons are expelled through the believers' invocation
moves.sitz: first sign in the charismatic catalogue

moves.label: M47
moves.paraphrase: They will speak in new languages.
moves.outcome: charismatic new speech
moves.sitz: second sign in the charismatic catalogue

moves.label: M48
moves.paraphrase: They will pick up serpents in their hands.
moves.outcome: serpents are handled without harm
moves.sitz: third sign in the charismatic catalogue

moves.label: M49
moves.paraphrase: Should they drink something deadly, it will do them no harm.
moves.outcome: the believers remain unharmed
moves.sitz: fourth sign in the charismatic catalogue

moves.label: M50
moves.paraphrase: They will lay their hands on those who are sick.
moves.outcome: therapeutic contact is made
moves.sitz: fifth sign in the charismatic catalogue

moves.label: M51
moves.paraphrase: Those sick people will recover their health.
moves.outcome: restored health for those touched
moves.sitz: outcome of the healing-touch sign

moves.label: M52
moves.paraphrase: After speaking to them, the Lord Jesus is lifted up into the sky.
moves.outcome: Jesus is removed from earthly presence into the sky
moves.sitz: scribal ascension-notice closing the commission

moves.label: M53
moves.paraphrase: He takes his seat at God's right hand.
moves.outcome: Jesus is enthroned beside God
moves.sitz: session-at-the-right-hand claim within the ascension-notice

moves.label: M54
moves.paraphrase: The eleven go out and proclaim the message in every place.
moves.outcome: the commission of M4 above is enacted in fact
moves.sitz: scribal fulfillment-notice closing the longer ending

moves.label: M55
moves.paraphrase: The Lord works alongside them as they proclaim.
moves.outcome: divine partnership accompanies the human proclamation
moves.sitz: claim of continuing risen-Lord agency after the ascension

moves.label: M56
moves.paraphrase: He also underwrites the message through the signs that follow along with it.
moves.outcome: the proclaimed word is publicly attested by miracle
moves.sitz: closing signs-and-wonders warrant for the mission-report
